office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Leah Taguba is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, sitting at the Auburn Justice Center, per her pamphlet statement.
highlights: Presides at the Auburn Justice Center and Community Court [S1]
States support for treatment courts and alternatives to jail where appropriate [S1]
